description:
Changed North Carolina (NC) statutes, by effective date, observation or session year.

source="effective" answers "what took effect on 1 October" from ncleg's own effective
dates — use it for that, and bound a single day with since=until. It looks FORWARD too,
so it also answers "what takes effect next quarter".

source="statutory" is the legislature's record from history notes, back to the 1800s,
dated by year. source="observed" is only when this database saw text change — ncleg's
publishing schedule, not the law's, and no substitute for effective dates.

"both" returns statutory + observed. For one section use amendment_history.

include_baseline.description: With observed changes: also include the rows from this database's first load, which record the start of the record, not a change in the law.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows per source (1-500).

since.description: Start of the window: a session year or an ISO date. Pair with `until` and source="effective" to ask about a single day.

source.description: "effective" (what took or takes effect, by ncleg's effective dates), "statutory" (session laws by year, from history notes), "observed" (when this database saw text change) or "both" (statutory and observed).

until.description: End of the window: a year or an ISO date, inclusive. Omit for no end; effective dates run into the future.

name: recent_law_changes
title: Recently changed North Carolina (NC) statutes
